summary_1line: Arjuna devastates Duhsasana’s elephant corps with relentless archery, causing massive slaughter and panic before Duhsasana retreats behind Drona’s formation.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna on his chariot drives straight into a charging host of armored elephants, arrows streaming from Gandiva as the beasts rear and crash down.
Huge elephants pierced with countless arrows collapse like falling mountains while blood pours from their mouths and riders tumble to the ground.
Severed warrior heads with golden earrings fall from elephant backs and scatter across the battlefield like lotus blossoms on the earth.
